title: Middle Eastern Maqluba with Boudin Blanc Variance
description: A vegetarian twist on the traditional Middle Eastern dish, featuring warm, velvety boudin blanc and a medley of eastern spices.

ingredients.name: boudin blanc
ingredients.notes: vegetarian alternative to traditional blood sausage

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the boudin blanc and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until lightly browned.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the maqluba rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a large serving dish or tagine.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
Optional: Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple green salad.
